macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks fell as yields rose, with all three major indexes lower
items.summary: The Dow fell 0.63%, the S&P 500 dropped 0.45%, and the Nasdaq Composite declined 0.78% as of the latest market snapshot. The 10-year Treasury yield was near 4.991%, keeping pressure on equities.

items.title: Federal Reserve kept rates unchanged and signaled focus on inflation progress
items.summary: Recent Fed messaging in the feed shows officials emphasizing a unanimous policy vote, removing references to supply shocks, and saying policy should support a timelier return to the 2% inflation goal. Traders are also watching comments that the Fed may need to keep policy restrictive.

items.title: Markets are pricing higher-for-longer rates amid renewed Fed hike bets
items.summary: Newsquawk reported that the dollar was mildly higher alongside oil and yields, with higher Fed rate-hike expectations reinforced by hawkish remarks from Fed officials. Separate coverage noted that markets were still debating the odds of another hike in October.

items.title: Swiss National Bank held rates at 0.00% and flagged FX market readiness
items.summary: The SNB left its policy rate unchanged at 0.00% and said it remains willing to be active in foreign-exchange markets as needed to ensure appropriate monetary conditions. That adds to the global central-bank focus alongside the Fed.

items.title: UK Bank of England held rates for a sixth straight meeting
items.summary: BBC reporting says the Bank of England kept rates unchanged again, while warning that high energy prices make a future increase more likely. The decision underscores the persistence of inflation concerns across major central banks.

items.title: U.S. equity futures and Asian stocks were pressured by oil and rate concerns
items.summary: Market coverage said Asian shares were subdued as rising oil prices revived rate-hike concerns, while U.S. equity-index futures and Treasuries slipped after geopolitical tensions lifted risk aversion. The macro backdrop remains dominated by energy and policy worries.

items.title: Trump's fuel-economy rollback boosted automakers in overnight trading
items.summary: Stellantis, Ford, and General Motors moved higher after reports that President Trump approved less stringent federal fuel-economy standards. The announcement was framed as supportive for cheaper cars and more U.S. auto jobs.

items.title: Chinese industrial-profit data pointed to improved factory earnings
items.summary: China's National Bureau of Statistics reported that industrial profits for January through August rose 15.7% year over year, according to local reporting. The data may help offset some concerns about the growth outlook in Asia.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum slipped while XRP and Solana moved unevenly
items.summary: Major crypto assets traded mixed over the past 24 hours, with Bitcoin around $84,057, Ethereum near $2,673, XRP near $1.52, and Solana up about 1.0%. Another market update showed Bitcoin near $83,248 and Ethereum near $2,648, indicating broad but modest weakness across large-cap tokens.

items.title: Crypto market saw heavy liquidations as prices softened
items.summary: Reports across the market showed substantial forced unwinding, including about $172 million in liquidations over 24 hours and another report of $270 million in leveraged positions being wiped out. These liquidations coincided with weaker trading in BTC and ETH.

items.title: Bitcoin briefly reclaimed the $85,000 level
items.summary: Market flash updates showed Bitcoin breaking back above $85,000, with one report putting BTC at 85,021.1 USDT and up 1.06% on the day. A separate market update also said BTC traded near $83,989, suggesting the move was not sustained across all venues.

items.title: Bitget hack and XRP withdrawal freeze remained a major security story
items.summary: Security coverage continued to center on the Bitget exploit, with reports saying XRP withdrawals were frozen and the theft estimate rose to $387.5 million. Another crypto news roundup said roughly 54 million stolen XRP had been moved.

items.title: Crypto Clarity Act odds fell below 10% on Polymarket
items.summary: Prediction-market data indicated that odds for the U.S. crypto 'Clarity Act' dropped below 10% for the first time. The move points to weakening near-term expectations for major U.S. crypto legislation.

items.title: Hong Kong regulators expanded cooperation on financial reporting oversight
items.summary: Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission and the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council signed a new memorandum of understanding to broaden regulatory cooperation for licensed institutions and fund financial reporting. The announcement is relevant to crypto firms operating in Hong Kong's regulated market.

items.title: Quant surged after bullish project developments
items.summary: Quant emerged as one of the biggest movers, with reports of gains ranging from about 10% to more than 70% and a separate flash saying QNT touched $373, up 90% on the day. Coverage linked the rally to a recent development involving The Clearing House selecting Quant for a tokenized deposit clearing network.

items.title: Bitwise filed for a NEAR ETF listing on the NYSE
items.summary: A crypto news roundup reported that Bitwise filed for a NEAR ETF with the New York Stock Exchange, marking another sign of expanding ETF activity beyond Bitcoin and Ether. The filing adds to the growing institutional product pipeline in digital assets.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Konami marks 40 years of Castlevania with classic mobile release
items.summary: Konami has brought a Castlevania classic to iOS and Android as part of the franchise’s 40th-anniversary coverage, making it the clearest notable game release in the latest roundup. The same roundup also highlights broader discussion around Xbox strategy and Fallout-related studio control changes.

items.title: Obsidian reportedly moved under Bethesda control for Fallout development
items.summary: A prominent industry item in the roundup says Obsidian Entertainment has effectively moved under Bethesda’s control and that the two will work together on Fallout development. If accurate, this would be a major organizational shift for one of Xbox’s best-known RPG studios.

items.title: Microsoft urged to clarify whether it wants to be a publisher or platform holder
items.summary: Former Xbox veteran John Kimmitch is quoted as saying Microsoft needs to clearly define whether it wants to act as a publisher or a platform holder. The comment reflects ongoing uncertainty around Xbox’s business direction and strategy.

items.title: Hyperboard Extreme launches free on Steam
items.summary: Game*Spark lists a free release for Hyperboard Extreme, described as a battle-racing game featuring cool girls competing on hoverboards. The item stands out as a new PC release among the available gaming headlines.

items.title: Wardogs surpasses 3 million sales on PC
items.summary: MP1st reports that Wardogs has sold more than 3 million units and accumulated very positive Steam reviews, marking it as one of the strongest recent PC success stories. The report says the game is still in early access and that console versions are not expected until at least 2028.

items.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered set for a free download for existing owners
items.summary: MP1st says CD Projekt Red is preparing The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered for release within the week and that current owners will be able to download it for free. This is one of the most notable upcoming game release updates in the results.

items.title: Meta VR Glasses tops 4Gamer’s weekly roundup of industry news
items.summary: 4Gamer’s weekly recap says Meta VR Glasses was the top story of the week, with a lighter form factor and a planned spring 2027 launch. The same roundup also highlights a new G’AIM’E model for gun-shooting gameplay on thin displays.

items.title: Free spooky cozy puzzler appears in Steam’s newest daily freebie roundup
items.summary: GamingBible’s archive notes a new Steam freebie described as a spooky, cozy puzzler, adding a small but recent release item to the day’s gaming news flow. The listing does not provide many details beyond its free availability and seasonal tone.
